title.zh: ⚡️Ledger盗币案新线索：经销商CryptoBilis 3月易主，股权登记指向中国籍人士
title.en: ⚡️Ledger盗币案新线索：经销商CryptoBilis 3月易主，股权登记指向中国籍人士

current_state.zh: CryptoBilis, the hardware wallet dealer under scrutiny for a suspected Ledger supply chain attack, was revealed to have changed ownership in March 2026 with a Chinese national holding 100% of shares since August 3, and has suspended all hardware wallet sales and shipments in Malaysia, the Philippines, and Indonesia.
